mam_pc.reserve_budget_tt: Reserve the stated remaining project budget in the common fund. This approval does not transfer it to the Emperor. Eligible contributions are advanced and executed individually; they share one remaining ceiling. No personal Gold is used.
mam_pc.budget_request_desc:
The ministries seek a remaining contribution budget of #high [mam_cf_quote|0]#! [treasury_i] for #high [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName]#!.

Revenue will finance eligible native contributions against this single ceiling. Required work may proceed without the new-project waiting period.
mam_pc.campaign_request_desc:
#high [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName]#! awaits the Grand Marshal's mandatory pledge. The proposed remaining budget is #high [mam_cf_quote|0]#! [treasury_i], including up to #high [mam_cf_mobilization|0]#! [treasury_i] for mobilization.

Approving authorizes the launch: funding the pledge can start war. Reducing the budget reduces the mobilization provision before the pledge. Existing upkeep remains separately serviced.
mam_pc.budget_approved_desc:
A remaining contribution budget of #high [mam_cf_quote|0]#! [treasury_i] is reserved for #high [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName]#!.

Eligible ministries may now execute covered contributions. Cash stays in common custody until needed. A Grand Marshal carrying out an approved campaign pledge can initiate war.
mam_pc.invoice_desc:
What shall my office provide for #high [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName]#!? Its remaining common budget is #high [mam_cf_project_remaining|0]#! [treasury_i]; recorded expenditure is #high [mam_cf_project_spent|0]#! [treasury_i].

Revenue advances the native price and carries out my chosen contribution. If more funds or higher authority are needed, I will submit the budget for approval first.
mam_pc.choose_invoice_tt: Fund and execute this exact native contribution with the current eligible minister. Its cost and rewards remain native. A covered contribution does not require another approval or a 90-day new-project cooldown. An uncovered invoice requests the lawful project budget first.
mam_pc.next_invoices_tt: Review the next eligible treasury contributions on this project. If none remain, return to the first contributions.
mam_pc.held_desc:
A public-account payment could not be verified. Further releases are held to prevent paying twice.

The contribution will not be retried until the account and its receipt have been reviewed. Existing project records remain in place.
mam_pc.debt_desc:
My office is in public debt. Its essential provision must be restored before a project advance can be spent on the intended contribution.

The project budget remains distinct from ordinary upkeep. No new contribution has been claimed.
mam_pc.cash_shortfall_desc:
The approved contribution to #high [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName]#! must wait for available common funds. Existing operating reserves and other project commitments remain protected.

A campaign cannot launch while its approved mobilization provision remains unpaid. The office will check again in seven days; this delay does not make another pledge or create treasury.
mam_pc.pending_desc:
The contribution budget for #high [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName]#! is awaiting its lawful reviewer.

The selected contribution remains attached to my request. Once adequate authorization is granted, the ministry will resume it without a duplicate funding request.
mam_pc.retry_desc:
The previous request concerning #high [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName]#! was not approved. A new budget request must wait until the thirty-day reconsideration period has passed.

Any earlier valid project commitment remains in place; this decision does not pay another contribution.
mam_pc.budget_submitted_tt: A remaining contribution budget of [mam_cf_budget_quote|0] [treasury_i] for [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName] has been submitted for the lawful review. No money moves until authorization and native contribution execution.
mam_pc.native_blocked_desc:
#high [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName]#! could not accept the chosen contribution under its current native requirements.

Any unspent advance is reconciled. Eligibility, Influence, cooldowns and project state are checked again before another attempt; an uncertain native payment is held.
mam_pc.no_invoice_desc:
No eligible unfunded treasury contribution is available on this page, or its project has changed.

Only contributions this office can provide are offered. Native contributions using other resources remain in the project's own controls.
mam_pc.invoice_paid_tt: [mam_cf_executing_contributor.GetShortUIName] completed a native contribution to [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName] for [mam_cf_execute_price|0] [treasury_i]. The common budget was reduced once; native participation and rewards remain with the contributor.
mam_pc.launch_desc:
The throne has authorized #high [mam_cf_selected_project.GetName]#! and reserved its public funds. My mandatory pledge costs #high [mam_cf_invoice_price|0]#! [treasury_i].

As Grand Marshal, I may now carry out the pledge. The native campaign will determine its targets and can begin the war immediately.
mam_pc.launch: Carry out the authorized campaign pledge.
mam_pc.launch_tt: Release the approved mobilization provision, advance the native pledge price and execute the Grand Marshal's mandatory contribution. This can start the Grand Campaign war. Native war leader, targets, casus belli and participant rules remain unchanged.
mam_pc.launch_authority_tt: Authorize the Grand Marshal’s required native pledge, which can begin the Grand Campaign war. Up to [mam_cf_mobilization|0] [treasury_i] of this budget provides one-time mobilization. Native pledge costs and existing operating commitments remain protected.
mam_pc.defer_launch: I need more time to prepare.
mam_pc.defer_launch_tt: Wait 30 days before presenting the launch again. No pledge is paid by deferring; the common project budget remains reserved.
mam_revenue_fund_contribute_project_inte: Revenue: Contribute to an Imperial Project
Choose a project and an eligible native contribution. Revenue finances and executes covered invoices; uncovered costs request the proper approval. Governors keep their own native contribution funds.
